reuse.why: Builds on the tree's WeekendRule object and getDateWithSkippedWeekend/getDayWithSkippedWeekend helpers, and every site (getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange, schedule-template) goes through them plus the new isSkippedWeekendOccurrence.

duplication.why: Weekend/holiday logic is defined once; only the short filter-then-move occurrence pipeline is repeated in getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange.

placement.why: Rules live in shared/schedules.ts; handlers in server/schedules/app.ts only compose them; rule data is carried via parseRecurDate.

scope.why: Each change serves one of the four requests; a release note is the only extra.

maintainability.why: Small named predicates (isDailyWeekendSkip, isHoliday, isNonWorkingDay) make the rule easy to extend; the holiday-count-scaled search window in getNextDate is a somewhat ad hoc bound.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No site re-checks isWeekend or holidays locally; all use the shared predicates.

disguised_duplication.where: The only overlap is the occurrence pipeline in getUpcomingDates/getDatesInRange, which calls the same shared predicates openly.

abstraction_drift.where: WeekendRule gains frequency and holidays fields; getDayWithSkippedWeekend gets a daily early return and getNextDate a daily search-window branch; no caller bypasses the shared helpers.
